en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a masonry bridge with an arched opening in the foreground, featuring a balustraded parapet. On the right side of the bridge are low buildings and tall cypress trees, with hills or mountains faintly visible in the background. Printed caption in French at the bottom reads "Le pont St. Lazare - ZANTE" and a modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the image.
